verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Manufact as a cloud-hosted platform ('Manufact Cloud') where you deploy MCP servers to their cloud, connect via dashboard, and manage via CLI/API — there is no mention of a self-hosted deployment option for the core Manufact platform itself (dashboard, observability, publish-checks). The CLI lets you run your own MCP server locally for development, but that is not the same as self-hosting Manufact's core product.
